name: Freecell Solitaire
author: Addicting Games
description: Freecell Solitaire is a classic card puzzle. Solitaire is not just a game it is a way of life. You shuffle your deck and play the cards you're dealt. This is the story of your life, this is the story of everyone's life. How you will deal with a King or a Jack when what you really need is an Ace or a Deuce is one of the many determining factors in who you are and who you may yet become. If you are feeling stuck with diamonds and spades when what you really want are hearts and clubs, then you know what it is to live life and ply Freecell Solitaire. In Freecell Solitaire there are no right answers there are only optimal and sub-optimal moves. Where you decide to place your cards when you decide to place them, how you shuffle your cards: all of it is a reflection of who you are as a person. In this way, we can see how the game of Freecell Solitaire reflects who we are as people. Stack cards in alternating colors and increasing numbers or store them one at a time in your free cell discard piles. The choice is yours. Look for the patterns, make the right moves and cash out a winner. Just like in real life.
